scope: Synchronized whole-model graph replay including Detect; v26 includes NMS-free device selection and final packing. Preprocessing, transfers and external IoU NMS excluded.
device_isolation: One exposed device; concurrent application services were not stopped. This is not an exclusive-machine benchmark.

protocol.order: thin,native on odd rounds; native,thin on even rounds
protocol.headline: median of five per-round medians
protocol.ratio: thin replay latency divided by native replay latency; greater than one is slower
